# @xanots/auth

> Xano's quick-start authentication (`auth/signup`, `auth/login`, `auth/me`, plus
> the `user`, `account`, and `event_log` tables and an event-log function),
> recreated as typed [xanots](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xanots/core) defs you
> register into a workspace and version behind npm. It is also the **reference
> xanots extension package**.

A xanots extension package exports plain, typed def objects (the factories
`table()`, `query()`, `defineFunction()`, `apiGroup()` are pure identity
functions). The *consumer's* `Xano` instance does all registration and encoding
via `export()`. This package pins no guids and no canonical — identity comes from
the consuming project's `xano.lock`, or falls back to `md5("<kind>:<name>")`.

## Install

```bash
npm install @xanots/auth @xanots/core@0.0.2-beta.4
```

Pin the **exact** `@xanots/core` version shown — it is the version this release's
golden-bundle contract was verified against. Prerelease semver ranges and the
`@beta` dist-tag both drift across beta tuples. Each release documents its tested
peer in the README.

## Quickstart

```ts
// xano/index.ts
import { workspace } from "@xanots/core";
import { registerAuth } from "@xanots/auth";

export default registerAuth(workspace("my-app"));
```

```bash
npx xanots export   # → importable workspace bundle
```

## Exports

- `registerAuth(xano)` — one-call install of the full set; returns the instance
  for chaining. Idempotency-guarded (throws on a second call per instance).
- Tables: `userTable` (auth table), `accountTable`, `eventLogTable`
- Function: `createEventLogFn`
- API: `authenticationGroup`, `signupQuery`, `loginQuery`, `meQuery`

Cherry-pick individual defs instead of `registerAuth` for granular control; keep
each def's dependencies together (queries need `userTable`; `createEventLogFn`
needs `eventLogTable`). Never register a def twice.

## Constraints for agents (read before using)

- **Exactly one auth table.** `userTable` is `auth: true`. Registering another
  `auth: true` table makes `export()` throw, and `auth/me` resolves `auth: true`
  to the single registered auth table.
- **Call `registerAuth` at most once per `Xano` instance** — it throws otherwise.
- **This is a faithful 1:1 port of Xano's quick-start template**; its quirks are
  preserved on purpose. Notably:
  - `event_log.metadata` stores the full fetched user record **including the
    password hash** on signup/login. Treat `event_log` like `user`.
  - Request history captures plaintext signup/login bodies and minted tokens —
    disable history on the Authentication group before production.
  - Every endpoint (including the `auth/me` GET) writes an `event_log` row; the
    table grows unbounded with no pruning.
  - A valid token for a deleted user → `auth/me` returns a `null` body, HTTP 200.
  - Tokens live 24h with no refresh or revocation.
- **Identity is the consumer's lock, not this package.** Commit `xano.lock` to
  keep guids and the API URL stable across re-imports.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): full endpoint reference, table shapes, and the complete
  "read before production" behavior notes.
- [docs/extending-xanots.md](docs/extending-xanots.md): the pattern for building
  your own xanots extension package (this package is the reference).
